document_title: CLARITHROMYCIN tablet, film coated (Aurobindo Pharma Limited), SPL v21, section 4.5 Lomitapide, Lovastatin, and Simvastatin
text: Concomitant administration of clarithromycin tablets with HMG-CoA reductase inhibitors (statins) that are extensively metabolized by CYP3A4 (lovastatin or simvastatin) is contraindicated, due to the increased risk of myopathy, including rhabdomyolysis [see Warnings and Precautions (5.4) and Drug Interactions (7)].
